② questionable contradicts. Original uses 'sound' as concession - plan may be financially sound (reasonable).

such a _____ would destroy architecture → renovation. Refers to the renovation plan discussed.
explore _____ that will preserve → alternatives. Writer urges exploring other options.
preserve the _____ of the Theater → character. The unique quality/identity of the building.
urge ≈ press. Both mean to strongly encourage or push someone to act.
preserve ≈ maintain. Both mean to keep something in its existing state.
explore ≈ investigate. Both mean to examine or look into something carefully.
destroy ↔ construct. Destroy means to demolish; construct means to build - direct opposites.
sacrifice ↔ safeguard. Sacrifice means to give up; safeguard means to protect - opposite actions.
(A) financially sound = 건전한 (adjective, meaning solid/reliable). (B) sound of orchestra = 소리 (noun, meaning noise).
to restore a building to good repair = renovate. Demolish destroys, abandon leaves, occupy inhabits.
_____ sound → adverb modifying adjective sound → financial → financially.
great _____ landmark → adjective before noun → history → historic.
architecture which is among _____ → the best of its kind in the nation. Architecture praised as nationally outstanding.
should not sacrifice for _____ → short-sighted financial gain. Writer's criticism of myopic profit motive.
